LanguageData.SD_CommandDesc:
Drivers take turns so the caravan can keep moving at night.
Each vehicle has a day driver and a night driver. From 6:00 to 18:00 the day driver drives. From 18:00 to 6:00 the night driver takes the wheel and the day driver sleeps in a passenger seat. Gunners stay at their turrets. The "Rest" button still stops the caravan.
The day driver is whoever is at the wheel during the day. The night driver is the most rested passenger who can drive, unless you choose one: right-click here, or put a pawn at the wheel during the night in the caravan's "Pawns" tab.
Turning this off puts every driver back in their seat.
